facts: NPM routing-host imports preserve source integer IDs. Preview and apply quarantine hostname conflicts and report the reason. Replaying an unchanged import reports it as unchanged.
risks: If an earlier import stored the hostname under a different ID, the new import reports the collision and leaves the existing host in place.
metrics: PR #26 passed CI and Container. The focused JUnit evidence covers three SQLite HTTP regressions and one live PostgreSQL sequence regression.
acceptance_criteria: Python Release and Container pass for v0.1.0a30.
